result_envelope.structured_content: Successful tools return the declared output_schema as MCP structuredContent.
result_envelope.text_content: A brief human-readable summary may accompany structuredContent; it is not a data format.
result_envelope.errors: The success schemas apply only to successful calls. MCP/JSON-RPC errors are error responses, not structuredContent success objects.

generate_draft.description: Generate a citation-backed draft reply for a thread using the app's RAG + LLM. No side effects — nothing is sent. Requires a licensed tier.

message_ids.description:
Explicit message ids to answer; defaults to all customer messages
after the last support reply.

thread_id.description: Thread to draft a reply for.

semantics: Uses Suovo's retrieval and configured model provider; model use may consume quota or incur cost. It returns a draft for review and never sends a message. `citations[].type` and `citation_sources[].type` are extensible identifiers.

field_descriptions.draft: Generated reply text for human editing; this tool does not send it.
field_descriptions.citations[].index: One-based display index assigned to this citation.
field_descriptions.citations[].heading: Source heading, or empty if none.
field_descriptions.citations[].type: Extensible source-kind identifier, or null when no type is available.
field_descriptions.citations[].thread_id: Related thread identifier for conversation-derived citations, or null.
field_descriptions.citation_sources[].count: Number of citations from this source kind.
field_descriptions.model: Configured model identifier used for generation.
field_descriptions.usage: Token usage reported by the model provider, or null when not reported.
field_descriptions.usage.prompt_tokens: Prompt tokens reported by the provider, or null.
field_descriptions.usage.completion_tokens: Completion tokens reported by the provider, or null.
field_descriptions.usage.total_tokens: Total tokens reported by the provider, or null.
field_descriptions.security.output_warnings: Generated-output safety findings; empty when none.
field_descriptions.security.safe: Whether configured output checks found the draft safe.
field_descriptions.security.verification.safe: Whether the verifier accepted the draft.
field_descriptions.citations: Source passages used to support the generated draft.
field_descriptions.citation_sources: Citation counts grouped by source kind.

get_thread.description: Get one thread with all messages (cached-first).

thread_id.description: Non-empty thread identifier from `list_threads` or `search_threads` (maximum 512 characters).

semantics: Cache-first retrieval of a thread and its messages. `from_cache` and `stale` describe the returned data.

field_descriptions.thread.id: Provider thread identifier used to retrieve the conversation.
field_descriptions.thread.subject: Thread subject; Suovo uses “(no subject)” if absent.
field_descriptions.thread.from: Sender of the latest message; “unknown” when there are no messages.
field_descriptions.thread.messages[].id: Provider message identifier, or null when unavailable.
field_descriptions.thread.messages[].body: Full message body when cached/fetched, or null when unavailable.
field_descriptions.thread.messages[].snippet: Provider message preview, or null when unavailable.
field_descriptions.thread.messages[].date: Message timestamp normalized to UTC RFC 3339 milliseconds, or null.
field_descriptions.thread.messages[].sender_is_support: Whether Suovo identifies the sender as the support account, or null when unknown.
field_descriptions.thread.snippet: Preview of the latest message; empty when there are no messages.
field_descriptions.thread.source: Provider owning the thread: gmail or allegro.
field_descriptions.thread.account_id: Provider account identifier, or null when unavailable.
field_descriptions.thread.from_cache: Whether messages were returned from Suovo's local cache.
field_descriptions.thread.stale: Whether the local messages may be stale.
field_descriptions.thread: Requested conversation and cache freshness information.

semantics: `visible` counts cached threads within the configured date window; `total` counts all cached threads.

field_descriptions.visible: Cached thread count within the configured email start-date window.
field_descriptions.after_date: Configured start-date cutoff normalized to UTC RFC 3339 milliseconds, or null.

semantics: `vram_gb` is null when the operating system cannot report it.

field_descriptions.ram_gb: Installed system memory in gibibytes as reported by the operating system.
field_descriptions.vram_gb: Available graphics memory in gibibytes, or null when unavailable.
field_descriptions.platform: Operating-system family: macos, windows, or linux.

list_accounts.description: Connected accounts: gmail auth status + marketplace (Allegro) accounts. Source of valid source/account_id values.
semantics: Returns account identifiers and connection state used by source/account filters.

field_descriptions.gmail.authenticated: Whether Gmail authentication is currently valid.
field_descriptions.gmail.cached_thread_count: Number of Gmail threads currently cached.
field_descriptions.gmail.linked: Whether a Gmail account is linked in Suovo.
field_descriptions.marketplace[].id: Allegro account identifier used to filter or address that account.
field_descriptions.marketplace[].is_active: Whether Suovo has this account enabled.
field_descriptions.marketplace[].cached_thread_count: Number of threads cached for this account.

list_models.description: List models available from the configured LLM provider.
semantics: Queries the configured model provider; provider configuration or availability can cause an error.

field_descriptions.models[].id: Model identifier returned by the configured language-model provider.
field_descriptions.models: Models available from the configured provider.

list_threads.description: List cached support threads (Gmail + Allegro), newest/most-urgent first. Filterable by needs_response/unread/processed/source/account.

account_id.description: Filter by account identifier returned by `list_accounts`.

needs_response.description: If set, include only threads that still need a support response when true.

processed.description: If set, include only threads marked processed when true or unprocessed when false.

source.description: Filter by provider. Values are `gmail` or `allegro`.

unread.description: If set, include only unread threads when true or read threads when false.

semantics: Returns offset-paginated cached results. `count` is this page's length, not the total. An empty page ends iteration. Cache changes during paging can shift later pages. Defaults: limit 50, offset 0.

field_descriptions.after_date: RFC 3339 cutoff from the configured email start date; null if unavailable.
field_descriptions.count: Number of thread summaries in this returned page, not the total matching count.
field_descriptions.from_cache: Whether the page was read from Suovo's local cache; this tool returns true.
field_descriptions.threads[].id: Provider thread identifier, accepted by get_thread and drafting/proposal tools.
field_descriptions.threads[].history_id: Gmail history identifier when available; null for providers without one.
field_descriptions.threads[].snippet: Cached message preview, or null when unavailable.
field_descriptions.threads[].subject: Thread subject, or null when unavailable.
field_descriptions.threads[].from: Sender address or display text, or null when unavailable.
field_descriptions.threads[].internal_date: Latest cached message time normalized to UTC RFC 3339 milliseconds, or null.
field_descriptions.threads[].is_unread: Whether the thread is currently marked unread, or null when unknown.
field_descriptions.threads[].needs_response: Whether Suovo marks the thread as needing a support response, or null when unknown.
field_descriptions.threads[].has_draft_reply: Whether Suovo has a saved draft reply, or null when unknown.
field_descriptions.threads[].source: Provider owning the thread: gmail or allegro, or null when unknown.
field_descriptions.threads[].account_id: Provider account identifier, or null when unavailable.
field_descriptions.threads: Page of matching cached thread summaries.

reply_review_get.description: Get one proposal's safe review metadata and refresh its provider thread context. This can update local queue freshness or staleness; it cannot send or deliver messages.

queue_item_id.description: Non-empty queue item identifier returned by `reply_review_propose` or `reply_review_list` (maximum 512 characters).

semantics: Refreshes provider thread context and may update local queue freshness or staleness. If live context is unavailable, the call may still succeed with `freshness: unverified` and an empty `thread_context`. It cannot send or deliver.

field_descriptions.queue_item_id: Same queue item identifier, provided for direct use with other queue tools.
field_descriptions.thread_id: Provider thread identifier linked to the proposal.
field_descriptions.provider: Provider owning the source thread: gmail or allegro.
field_descriptions.customer_label: Display-safe customer label; currently the generic label Customer.
field_descriptions.question: Customer question captured when the proposal was created.
field_descriptions.created_at: Proposal creation time in UTC RFC 3339 format.
field_descriptions.proposed_body: Full current proposed reply body for review.
field_descriptions.thread_context: Provider messages used to assess whether the proposal is current.
field_descriptions.thread_context[].id: Provider message identifier, or null when unavailable.
field_descriptions.thread_context[].body: Full message body, or null when unavailable.
field_descriptions.thread_context[].snippet: Message preview, or null when unavailable.
field_descriptions.thread_context[].date: Message timestamp normalized to UTC RFC 3339 milliseconds, or null.
field_descriptions.thread_context[].sender: Message sender address or marketplace login, or null when unavailable.
field_descriptions.thread_context[].sender_is_support: Whether Suovo identifies the sender as the support account.
field_descriptions.freshness: current, stale, or unverified; unverified means live context could not be confirmed.

reply_review_list.description: List safe metadata for items in Suovo's shared Reply Review Queue. This is read-only and cannot send or deliver messages.
semantics: Offset pagination. `next_offset: null` means no next page; when present, reuse that offset unchanged. Proposal text is included in the result.

field_descriptions.items[].queue_item_id: Same queue item identifier, provided for direct use with other queue tools.
field_descriptions.items[].thread_id: Provider thread identifier linked to the proposal.
field_descriptions.items[].provider: Provider owning the source thread: gmail or allegro.
field_descriptions.items[].customer_label: Display-safe customer label; currently the generic label Customer.
field_descriptions.items[].question: Customer question captured when the proposal was created.
field_descriptions.items[].created_at: Proposal creation time in UTC RFC 3339 format.
field_descriptions.next_offset: Offset to use unchanged for the next page, or null when there is no next page.

reply_review_propose.description: Create a proposal in Suovo's shared Reply Review Queue. This records a draft for human review and cannot send or deliver messages.

body.description: Proposed reply body for human review; non-empty after trimming and at most 100,000 Unicode scalar values. Creating a proposal never sends it.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-stable idempotency key matching `[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}`. Replaying the same request returns its existing result; reusing the key for a different request conflicts.

thread_id.description: Canonical thread id from the existing thread tools.

semantics: Persists a local proposal for human review; it cannot send or deliver. Idempotency keys match `[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}`. Replaying an identical request returns the existing result; a different request with the same key conflicts.

field_descriptions.queue_item_id: Identifier of the local queue item created or returned for this idempotent request.
field_descriptions.state: Queue state after proposal creation; currently needs_review.

reply_review_update.description: Create a new human-review proposal revision in Suovo's shared Reply Review Queue. This records content for review and cannot send or deliver messages.

body.description: Replacement proposal body; non-empty after trimming and at most 100,000 Unicode scalar values. The sidecar creates a new immutable revision.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-stable idempotency key matching `[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}`. Replaying the same request returns its existing result; reusing the key for a different request conflicts.

queue_item_id.description: Non-empty queue item identifier to revise (maximum 512 characters).

semantics: Persists a new immutable local proposal revision for human review; it cannot send or deliver. Idempotency behavior matches `reply_review_propose`.

field_descriptions.queue_item_id: Identifier of the updated local queue item.
field_descriptions.revision: Positive new immutable proposal revision number.
field_descriptions.state: Queue state after update; currently needs_review.

search_knowledge.description: Semantic search over the local knowledge base; returns chunks with sources and scores.

k.description: Number of matching chunks to return (default 5).

query.description: What to look up in the knowledge base.

thread_context.description: Optional thread text to bias retrieval.

semantics: An empty `results` array means no matching passages were returned.

field_descriptions.results[].source: Local knowledge source label, commonly a file name.
field_descriptions.results[].heading: Heading associated with the passage; empty if none.
field_descriptions.results[].score: Suovo's retrieval relevance score; compare results within a query.
field_descriptions.results: Retrieved knowledge passages ordered by relevance.

search_threads.description: Search threads by subject, sender or snippet; same filters as list_threads.

account_id.description: Filter by account identifier returned by `list_accounts`.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching threads to return (default 50).

needs_response.description: If set, include only threads that still need a support response when true.

offset.description: Number of matching threads to skip (default 0).

processed.description: If set, include only threads marked processed when true or unprocessed when false.

query.description: Search string matched literally against cached subject, sender, and snippet fields.

source.description: Filter by provider. Values are `gmail` or `allegro`.

unread.description: If set, include only unread threads when true or read threads when false.

semantics: Searches cached subject, sender, and snippet fields and returns offset-paginated results. `count` is this page's length, not the total. An empty page ends iteration; cache changes can shift later pages. Defaults: limit 50, offset 0.

field_descriptions.after_date: RFC 3339 cutoff from the configured email start date; null if unavailable.
field_descriptions.count: Number of matching thread summaries in this returned page, not the total matching count.
field_descriptions.from_cache: Whether cache status is known; null when the search result does not report it.
field_descriptions.threads[].id: Provider thread identifier, accepted by get_thread and drafting/proposal tools.
field_descriptions.threads[].history_id: Gmail history identifier when available; null for providers without one.
field_descriptions.threads[].snippet: Cached message preview, or null when unavailable.
field_descriptions.threads[].subject: Thread subject, or null when unavailable.
field_descriptions.threads[].from: Sender address or display text, or null when unavailable.
field_descriptions.threads[].internal_date: Latest cached message time normalized to UTC RFC 3339 milliseconds, or null.
field_descriptions.threads[].is_unread: Whether the thread is currently marked unread, or null when unknown.
field_descriptions.threads[].needs_response: Whether Suovo marks the thread as needing a support response, or null when unknown.
field_descriptions.threads[].has_draft_reply: Whether Suovo has a saved draft reply, or null when unknown.
field_descriptions.threads[].source: Provider owning the thread: gmail or allegro, or null when unknown.
field_descriptions.threads[].account_id: Provider account identifier, or null when unavailable.
field_descriptions.threads: Page of thread summaries matching the query and filters.
